name: Darbuka malfuf dum-tek
desc: Middle-Eastern darbuka playing the malfuf 2/4 groove: a low center Dum on the downbeat (speed .62) against crisp rim Teks (speed 1.4) on the off-eighths, soft ka fills, dub delay, a slow filter breath and opposite-phase pan drift. Full adds a rotating ka euclid and a lastOf(4) doumbek roll; peak is a driving 16th-note tek roll with iter rotation.

code.full: stack(s("darbuka ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ <~ darbuka>").speed(.62).gain(${gain}*.9).shape(.4).lpf(sine.range(1200,2800).slow(24)), s("~ ~ darbuka ~ darbuka ~ darbuka ~").speed("<1.4 1.45>").gain(${gain}*.7).shape(.3).hpf(600).pan(cosine.range(.38,.62).slow(16)), s("[~ darbuka]*4").speed(1.55).gain("[.25 .35 .2 .3]").hpf(900).pan(sine.range(.5,.7).slow(20)), s("darbuka(3,8,<0 2 4 6>)").speed(1.5).gain(${gain}*.45).hpf(1100)).lastOf(4, x=>x.fast(2)).room(${room}).delay(${dly}).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.28).fast(${rate}).orbit(2).play()
code.peak: stack(s("darbuka ~ darbuka ~ ~ ~ darbuka ~").speed(.62).gain(${gain}*.9).shape(.4).lpf(sine.range(1400,3200).slow(16)), s("~ darbuka darbuka ~ darbuka ~ darbuka darbuka").speed("<1.4 1.5>").gain(${gain}*.7).shape(.3).hpf(650).pan(cosine.range(.35,.65).slow(12)), s("darbuka*16").speed(1.55).gain("[.28 .15 .22 .12]*4").hpf(1000).pan(sine.range(.45,.72).slow(16)), s("darbuka(5,16,<0 4 8 12>)").speed(1.6).gain(${gain}*.4).hpf(1200)).lastOf(2, x=>x.fast(2)).iter(4).room(${room}).delay(${dly}).delaytime(.1875).delayfeedback(.3).fast(${rate}).orbit(2).play()
